Trends · fixed 30 days (pinned 30d cohort cache, chip flips never re-run

HubKpiInfoPopover; quick-tools row removed; Top Creators rebuilt as a Card
with neutral avatars + labelled ranking-window control; charts moved to
theme-consistent colors (emerald signups/FTDs pair, var(--color-cost));
docked-alerts header flattened; honest 365d label for the old All chip;
one shared dashboard skeleton for loading.tsx + in-page fallbacks.
